title: Minimum Sum of Mountain Triplets II
sourceKind: secondary mirror (leetcode.doocs.org/en/lc/2909, paraphrased); official page not retrievable
summary: Find indices i<j<k with nums[i] < nums[j] and nums[k] < nums[j]; return the minimum nums[i]+nums[j]+nums[k], or -1.
visualizationNotes: Visualization caps nums at 50 elements; the Python solution accepts the full constraint range. Difficulty tag not taken from a source.
